name: Kaitumjaure-Teusajaure
estimatedTime: 3-5 or 4-5 hours depending on official source
description: Kaitumjaure to Teusajaure. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF route overview lists 9 km, 4-5 hours; STF section page and Naturkartan were reported as 3-5 hours.
STF quick facts reportedly list 500-620 m elevation, while STF narrative gives high point 780 m and Naturkartan says just over/about 800 m.
Naturkartan title matches official Kaitumjaure-Teusajaure order, but GPX points are Teusajaure-to-Kaitumjaure.
Project candidate section is 7, STF route-group stage is 4 and OSM calls the relation Kungsleden Etapp 11.
Official and AllTrails evidence leans easy, while field reports stress stony climbs, exposure, wind and steep descent.
Boat crossing exists, but timetable/current rowboat deployment details are date-sensitive and some source details are 2025 or older.
Sjaunja/Laponia overlap is confirmed, but exact reserve subarea overlap was not resolved from static sources.

facilities.name: STF Kaitumjaure Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF hut at the start of this section, with two guest cabins, about 30 beds, self-catering kitchen, small shop, sauna, limited pet rooms, no mobile coverage and water fetched from stream/lake depending on season.
facilities.routeProximity: start endpoint; about 20 m from Naturkartan route endpoint and about 0.6 m from OSM route endpoint
